why: PROP-EXEC fix-forward #5. Dry run #13942 (04:01Z, code_sha 37da6d6e7 includes #13935) FOUND the footer submit ('Buy 49 SOLUSD at 117.77', in the column, below the visible form), which closes the locator problem. No behaviour change on the success path. Tier 2: order-entry diagnostics on a funded prop account.
